title: Blizzard reveals Diablo 5 with multiplayer, classic classes, and 2029 launch
summary: Blizzard confirms Diablo 5 details, including full multiplayer, classes inspired by Diablo 3, connection with Dragon Age, and a Netflix series, with launch planned for spring 2029.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever arrives as 'Classic+' experience with controller support and new races
summary: Blizzard launches World of Warcraft: Forever, an alternative version of the MMO with native controller support, no separate realms, and a paid Skyborne race, sparking debate among players.

title: StarCraft returns as open-world shooter for 2030 focused on single-player
summary: Blizzard announces a StarCraft reboot as a third-person shooter with defined narrative, single-player campaign, and 2030 launch, moving away from traditional RTS.

title: Blizzard cancels annual Diablo 4 expansions and bets on seasons until Diablo 5
summary: Diablo 4 will not receive more paid expansions; Blizzard will focus on seasonal content and the Switch 2 release while preparing Diablo 5.

title: Cyberpunk 2077 arrives on Battle.net and Geralt of Rivia joins Diablo 4 in CD Projekt-Blizzard alliance
summary: CD Projekt RED and Blizzard expand their collaboration: Cyberpunk 2077 integrates into Battle.net and The Witcher 3 crosses over with Diablo 4 through shared content.

title: Warcraft 3 Reforged adds secret levels and requires permanent connection, removing LAN
summary: The Warcraft 3 Reforged update introduces two hidden maps and removes LAN mode, requiring constant online connection.

title: Inzoi revolutionizes life simulators with focus on individual characters and multiplayer mode
summary: The Inzoi simulator differentiates from The Sims by focusing on a single character and announces a Ready Player One-style multiplayer mode.

title: Overwatch closes its first annual narrative arc and introduces heroine Doctrine
summary: Overwatch concludes its year-long story and adds Doctrine, whose attack speed forces Blizzard to review upgrade limits.

title: Zelda and Professor Layton developers criticize AI use in prototypes and presentations
summary: The Majora's Mask art director faces criticism for using AI in tests, while Level-5 admits employing it to make its showcase 'more spectacular'.
